crossRefs.note: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?
Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?
He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside…
He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish…
“There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

translations.web: Don’t you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?
translations.bsb: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
translations.kjv: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
translations.asv: Do ye not yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
